topic: Myth: A part-time job teaches more than a side hustle
caption:
A job teaches your teen to follow instructions.

A side hustle teaches them to think, create, and earn on their own terms.

Both have value — but only one builds an entrepreneurial mindset that follows them for life.

See how it works → hustleup.us
